rule_selection_reason: existence_to_counting 能最根本地改变问题性质，从判存在变成统计合法序列数量，引入全新的组合计数责任，创新度远超仅优化阈值的 feasibility_to_extremal_threshold；同时计数对象直接生长于原题解空间，比 forward_solution_to_inverse_design 的外部修改操作更自然，而 construct_or_obstruction 因局部证据难以定义而不适用。；创新度判断：将原题“是否存在合法序列”的核心义务替换为“有多少种不同的合法动作序列”，迫使从单一可行性检查转向组合计数，并必须定义等价类、状态转移与去重规则。；难度判断：要求解法在能量约束下正确计数所有合法序列，处理大范围状态的动态规划或组合数推导，远高于简单的公式判定，尤其在添加取模要求后难度显著抬升。；风险判断：原题数据范围极大（M 可达 1e9 秒），可能使直接 DP 不可行，需通过约束调整或数学闭式解控制规模，否则题目不可解；若能量参数设计不当，计数可能退化为平凡组合数，需在题目设计中通过能量限制避免。

components.role_description: Three integers X, R, M representing initial energy, required run minutes, and allowed total minutes

constraints.name: energy_capacity
constraints.description: Energy cannot exceed X units. Resting when energy is already X yields no increase.

constraints.name: energy_nonnegative_run_condition
constraints.description: Running is forbidden when energy is 0.

constraints.name: energy_change_rules
constraints.description: Running decreases energy by 1; resting increases energy by 1, but not above X.

constraints.name: run_requirement
constraints.description: A total of R units of run time must be accumulated.

constraints.name: deadline
constraints.description: The goal must be reached within M time units.

objective.description: Determine whether Ann can finish the race within the given time limit

invariants.name: energy_balance_bound
invariants.description: In any valid schedule, the total required running seconds (R*60) must not exceed the initial energy X plus the maximum recoverable energy, which is the total available resting seconds ((M-R)*60). This gives a necessary and sufficient condition: when M < R it is impossible, otherwise feasible iff required ≤ X + maximal recovery.

details.feedback: 该规则不适用，因为缺少自然的对抗选择结构。建议寻找本身包含两个玩家或具有轮流操作机制的种子题。
